1.consolidated_definition: Peinado de varón que consiste en echar el pelo para atrás, liso y pegado con vaselina al cuero cabelludo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Male hairstyle in which the hair is brushed back and smoothed against the scalp with vaseline.
